review.observation: Full original: pale smooth skin, long tail fin and branching external gills behind the flattened head. The gills are natural head/neck paint, not ears, and are not removed. Four slender limbs are visible at different heights; ground contact and toe interpretation remain held.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. External gills, ear openings and all other actual head/neck paint remain present and are not excluded.
